title: Peace pact ends tribal dispute at Kalinga in Cordillera

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — After decades of conflict, the Kalinga sub-tribes of Lubuagan and Mabongtot in the Cordillera have agreed to end hostilities and rebuild their bodong (indigenous security and social agreement), sealing the reconciliation with a peace pact on Monday. The agreement was formalized at the Kalinga Sports Complex Function Hall through a sipat (cessation of hostilities) and allasiw (traditional exchange of tokens) to affirm peace and renewed relations. Three families involved in the conflict received P1.5 million in settlement assistance. The Ando, Jaime, and Lumpao families each received P500,000.
